bibl.title: Kreditkauf and Lieferungskauf as economical phenomena in the practice of the agoranomoi. Reconsideration of the contract under BGU I 174 and 189.
bibl.seg: Szilvia Nemes, Kreditkauf and Lieferungskauf as economical phenomena in the practice of the agoranomoi. Reconsideration of the contract under BGU I 174 and 189.
bibl.note: Description of the problem. - The solution of the legal practice. - Conclusion. - B.G.U. I, 174+189 falls into the group called bilingual Fayum sale-loan deeds. These Fayum double contracts were not sales with immediate effect, but suspended sales, akin to ordinary hypothecs.
